Here's the latest on Fervo Energy (Nasdaq: FRVO), based on fresh reporting:

**Commercial operation at Cape Station — ahead of schedule**
Fervo declared commercial operation at its first Cape Station power plant in Beaver County, Utah, on September 30, 2026 — one day ahead of its contractual commercial operation date. The first GeoBlock reached 33 MW of net power production, meeting the PPA threshold, and is now generating revenue under Fervo's power purchase agreement. Cape Station synchronized to the grid on September 24 and moved to COD just six days later, making it the first greenfield enhanced geothermal development in the world to reach contractual commercial operations. The facility was built and commissioned in just 23 months.
- https://fervoenergy.com/fervo-energy-declares-commercial-operation-at-cape-station-ahead-of-schedule-leading-the-race-for-next-generation-geothermal-energy/
- https://www.renewableenergymagazine.com/geothermal/fervo-energy-declares-commercial-operation-at-cape-20261002

"Reaching commercial operations at Cape Station is both a huge milestone for Fervo, and a turning point for the entire energy industry," said CEO and Co-Founder Tim Latimer. "No team has ever built a project like this anywhere in the world, and we did it ahead of schedule."
- https://www.linkedin.com/posts/megan-baldino-66636469_if-you-dont-know-about-the-groundbreaking-activity-7512531987363033088-ymDD

**First Power milestone (September 24, 2026)**
Cape Station achieved First Power — the first time a utility-scale greenfield EGS development has reached that milestone anywhere in the world — coming just over four months after Fervo's May 2026 IPO. Cape Station has roughly 900 MW fully contracted and more than 4 GW of planned capacity.
- https://fervoenergy.com/fervo-energy-achieves-first-power-at-cape-station-a-landmark-moment-for-the-future-of-enhanced-geothermal-systems/
- https://finance.yahoo.com/energy/articles/fervo-hits-first-power-cape-120500060.html

**What's next on the build-out**
Phase I is an approximately 100 MW installation of three ~33 MW GeoBlocks; GeoBlocks 2 and 3 are expected to hit initial power in early 2027 and ramp toward full production. Phase II is expected to add roughly 400 MW via eight 50-MW GeoBlocks in 2028, using Fervo's 3.0 well design.
- https://finance.yahoo.com/energy/articles/fervo-hits-first-power-cape-120500060.html

**Other recent items**
- Fervo launched "Ground Truth," a six-part podcast on the creation of the company (October 8, 2026), and its newsroom also lists the commercial operation announcement and First Power.
